previous_story:
Drifting through Mars’s red dust, Maya listened to the static. Every night, a rogue frequency carried Leo’s voice from a Chilean observatory—a twenty-minute delay spanning millions of miles. 

Tonight, his message changed. "I know this signal reaches Solis Base, Maya. I stopped looking at the stars; I’m looking for you."

Her heart racing, Maya flipped the transmitter on. "Leo, I—"

Suddenly, the storm cut the feed. Come back for the next part tomorrow.
